title: Little Rabbit Foo Foo
description: A delightful rendition of Little Rabbit Foo Foo for children.

lyrics.text: Little Rabbit Foo Foo, hopping through the forest,
Scooping up the field mice and bopping them on the head.
Down came the Good Fairy, and she said,
Little Rabbit Foo Foo, I don't want to see you scooping up the field mice!
